The door is in the SHORT wall facing the yard. ONE SQUARE FOUR-PANE WINDOW sits in the LONG wall, with a WORKBENCH running the full length of that wall beneath it. Shelves and a pegboard above the bench. A single bare bulb on a flex. The camera may come closer or pull wider, and may stand anywhere in the room, BUT IT NEVER CROSSES THE ROOM'S AXIS: the doorway is never on the right, the bench and window are never on the left, and the room is never mirrored. It is a SMALL room, three metres by four, and the ceiling is barely above an adult's head.
